### Widgets

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.widget`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.widget.Widgets → org.dreambot.api.methods.widget.Widgets  

**Methods:**
```java
static boolean closeAll();
static WidgetChild get(int ... ids);
static WidgetChild get(int parent, Filter <WidgetChild> filter);
static WidgetChild get(Filter <WidgetChild> filter);

static List<WidgetChild> getAllContainingText(String text);

static int[] getWidgetYArray();

static boolean isWidgetSelected();
static void setSelectedWidgetId(int id);
static void setSelectedWidgetIndex(int index);
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `closeAll()` | This will attempt to close out of any interfaces that might be opened that are on the game screen |
| `get(int ... ids)` | Gets WidgetChild based on the given ids Null checks each layer |
| `get(int parent, Filter <WidgetChild> filter)` | Returns the first widget matching the filter for the given parent ID, terminating as soon as one is found. |
| `get(Filter <WidgetChild> filter)` | Returns the first widget matching the filter, terminating as soon as one is found. |
| `getAll(Filter <WidgetChild> filter)` | Gets a List of widget children that match the filter provided |
| `getAllContainingText(String text)` | Gets a list of the WidgetChild containing a particular search string Try to avoid using this method if you can (ie. |
| `getAllWidgets()` | Gets all the Widget s |
| `getSelected()` | Gets the currently selected WidgetChild based on getSelectedWidgetId() and getSelectedWidgetIndex() |
| `getSelectedWidgetId()` | Gets the currently selected widget ID (child ID) -1 if none selected |
| `getSelectedWidgetIndex()` | Gets the currently selected widget index (grandchild ID) -1 if selected widget is not a grandchild or if none selected |
| `getWidget(int id)` | Gets top level parent Widget based on the id |
| `getWidgetXArray()` | Deprecated. removed in 1.12.21 |
| `getWidgetYArray()` | Deprecated. removed in 1.12.21 |
| `isOpen()` | This checks if any non-default interfaces are open that block the game screen (even partially) |
| `isVisible(int ... ids)` | Checks if a WidgetChild is visible |
| `isWidgetSelected()` | Checks to see if you have a widget selected |
